caption: This tonkotsu ramen features a rich, creamy yellow broth, topped with chashu pork, sliced green onions, and a large nori sheet. Served in a white bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, ambient light, with a menu visible in the background.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture under soft lighting.
The chashu pork is a thick, oval slice with pinkish meat, white fat marbling, and a glossy surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, with visible veins and slightly curled edges.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, smooth, and slightly viscous, with visible noodles and toppings partially submerged.
White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, featuring black Japanese characters and red seal on its rim.
